name: Philip
description: A Phrygian by country, left by Antiochus as governor at Jerusalem, more barbarous in manner than the king who set him there; burned a company of sabbath-keepers found hiding in caves near the city; later, seeing Judas increase in strength, wrote to Ptolemeus the governor of Celosyria and Phenice for more aid

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
